verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides official developer SDKs (CUDA Toolkit, CUDA Tile C++, cuTile Python, Nsight Compute/Systems) and curated AI SDKs/backends (PyTorch, Ollama, Windows ML) that developers can build against on RTX GPUs, backed by a live developer portal. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration, deeper API reference documentation, and agent-specific SDK examples beyond general CUDA/AI tooling.
